summary: Manulife Private Credit Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (BDC, file 814-01664), filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition by John Hancock Comvest Private Income Fund via a two-step merger with merger sub John Hancock Comvest Merger Sub, LLC. Amendment No. 1 to the June 22, 2026 Merger Agreement permits issuance of fractional Acquiror Class I Common Shares with no cash-in-lieu and eliminates transmittal/surrender requirements for book-entry shares, with the exchange agent crediting accounts and mailing transaction notices. MPCF advisory and service agreements terminated post-effective time. No price, premium, or close date disclosed; routine closing mechanics now govern.
